title: */35 in the minute field: step does not mean interval

normative.title: crontab(5), Vixie/cronie lineage
normative.quote: steps are evaluated just within the field they are applied to

expect.note: Fires at :00 and :35 of every hour — NOT every 35 minutes.

cron-parser[strict]@tzle2026a.error: Error: Invalid cron expression, expected 6 fields

rationale: The most-reported cron misunderstanding, and one the man page actually settles. It is NORMATIVE, and it is also the vector that proves cron cannot express 'every N minutes' for N not dividing 60.

cases.note: Quartz semantics: 5, 25, 45 — the bare value is a lower bound and the range runs to the field maximum.
